attribution.note: Marcus directly asserts the limitation in his own voice.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves the categorical limitation and the restriction to LLMs alone. In context, it asserts an enduring capability limit, rather than merely describing models available in 2022.

contract.note: The surrounding discussion makes human-level general intelligence and language-only learning fair ordinary readings. The contract reasonably excludes assisted systems and requires broad evidence, although Marcus supplies no operational threshold.

evidence.note: Dated before the cutoff and relevant to general capabilities. Broad GPT-4 performance and an incomplete-AGI characterization do not establish independently validated, language-only human-level general intelligence.
The dated theoretical analysis concerns restricted prompt communication and output constraints. Its limits on universal task solving do not establish the broader impossibility asserted here.
The study predates the cutoff but evaluates combined model-and-harness systems on bounded games. Its results establish neither LLM-only general intelligence nor a general impossibility.

reviews.rationale: Neither early-resolution condition is met. The packet contains no independently validated language-only system demonstrating human-level general intelligence and no impossibility result covering that capability and model class. With no deadline, continued absence of a qualifying system cannot support the categorical limitation.
